abstract: We report a case of epignathus teratoma diagnosed at 22 weeks of gestation in which 3-dimensional ultrasound (3DUS) was useful to plan perinatal management. A significant enlargement of the tumor, associated with polyhydramnios and preterm labor, was observed at 35 weeks of gestation. After amniotic fluid evacuation, 3DUS was performed in the presence of pediatricians, obstetricians, and otolaryngologists. Three-dimensional ultrasound revealed that great part of the tumor was located outside the fetal mouth and anterior to fetal mandible, suggesting that the newborn could breathe spontaneously by nasal via. A cesarean section with longitudinal hysterotomy was performed at 36 weeks followed by an immediate extirpation of the tumor and the intubation of the newborn. The management of this rare case illustrates that the ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedure is not always necessary in this situation. Besides, the actual prenatal goal consists on carefully selecting fetuses with epignathus teratoma that will need the EXIT procedure from those that will not. Three-dimensional ultrasound and magnetic resonance imaging in association with 2DUS can be helpful in this prenatal selection.
abstract_ja: 妊娠22週で診断された大型の口咽頭奇形腫(エピグナタス奇形腫)の症例を報告する。35週で腫瘍の著明な増大に伴う羊水過多と早産の兆候が認められた。羊水除去後、小児科医、産科医、耳鼻咽喉科医の立ち会いのもとで三次元超音波検査(3DUS)を実施した。3DUSにより、腫瘍の大部分は胎児の口の外側かつ下顎の前方に位置しており、新生児は鼻腔経由で自発呼吸できる可能性が示唆された。36週に長軸子宮切開を伴う帝王切開を施行し、直ちに腫瘍を摘出して新生児に気管挿管を行った。本症例の管理は、分娩時子宮外治療(EXIT)手技が必ずしも必要ではないことを示している。また、今後の出生前診断の課題は、EXIT手技を必要とする胎児と必要としない胎児を慎重に選別することである。三次元超音波検査は、二次元超音波検査および磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)と併用することで、出生前の選別に有用となりうる。
